name: Johor Plantations Group Berhad
overview: 2026年JPG没有公布新增产能、新业务或出售业务；业务动态主要是每月/每季公布棕油、鲜果串和棕仁的产量，以及持续更新与PIJ Holdings的MOU（无重大进展）。产量方面，2026年第三季CPO产量83,779.25公吨，同比减少10.79%，但较上一季增加16.29%。
overview_en: In 2026, JPG announced no new capacity, new business lines or divestments; its business updates consisted mainly of monthly/quarterly production figures for CPO, FFB and palm kernel, plus recurring updates on the MOU with PIJ Holdings (no material development). In Q3 2026, CPO production was 83,779.25 MT, down 10.79% YoY but up 16.29% QoQ.

segments.name: 上游
segments.note: 2026年持续公布棕油、鲜果串和棕仁月度及季度产量，第三季产量同比减少、环比增加。
segments.note_en: In 2026, continued to announce monthly and quarterly production of CPO, FFB and palm kernel; Q3 output declined YoY but rose QoQ.
